script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Meanwhile, Jupiter forms a harmonious trine to your 10th House cusp, boosting your ambitions and opening unexpected advancement doors. If you're single, an air of sensual confidence draws charismatic admirers who speak your language of comfort. Avoid making any sudden property purchases if tempted under the square's pressure—wait for Jupiter's trine clarity before signing. Follow for tomorrow's reading to stay ahead of the cosmic shift.
